integrity: Exact all-order proof from a four-class symbolic species decomposition; finite verification is supplementary rather than an infinite proof. No fabricated author, independence, or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The general semantic frame correspondence is previously known. The new claim is the all-orientations labelled-tree bivariate EGF. No claims about digraphs with cycles or a closed-form asymptotic. One closely relevant out-tree record was accessible only in published summary form. Independent historical priority and independent mathematical validation have not been performed.
title: Non-contingency introspection on all orientations of finite trees: independent branching and a bivariate labelled census
